about: Turn everything merged so far into a numbered release.
prepareAbout: The kobold reads what was merged, suggests the number and drafts the notes, only when you press Prepare.
notANumber: Use three numbers with dots, like 1.4.3.
notHigher: It has to be higher than {{last}}.
whyUnknown: The kobold could not tell what changes for people, so check this number.
first: This is the first release: everything merged so far is in it.
reading: Reading the merged work and the releases from GitHub…
couldNotRead: The releases could not be read

needsRepository.title: Releases need a GitHub repository
needsRepository.text: A release is a tag and a release on GitHub, so a repository has to be connected first.
needsRepository.link: Connect one in Settings, under Where work is tracked.

notesAbout: Written by the kobold from what was merged, in English, Italian and German. They go on the release as they are.
notesListed: The kobold wrote no notes, so the release lists the pull requests merged.
